proposal.summary: Prior to version 1.18.7, DataEase contains a deserialization vulnerability in the datasource component that can be exploited to execute arbitrary code; fixed in v1.18.7. No workarounds besides upgrading are available.
proposal.cwe_quote: a deserialization vulnerability exists in the DataEase datasource, which can be exploited to execute arbitrary code.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review a minimal public proof-of-concept and exact vulnerable code path (file and function) to confirm the attack vector and whether authentication is required; if confirmed, publish advisory with CVE and mitigation (upgrade to v1.18.7).
